meta.title: IN A PINCH
meta.tagline: when you gotta go, you gotta go
meta.checkedLabel: November 2026 · source dates shown per listing
meta.coverage: Documented stops plus a central-area OpenStreetMap venue snapshot. Additional mapped venues are discovered as the map is explored. This is not an exhaustive census of real businesses.
meta.coordinateLicense: OpenStreetMap-derived coordinates © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0. Official source links accompany facility facts.
meta.mapAttribution: Geography and some facility information © OpenStreetMap contributors; ODbL 1.0. Operator and municipal sources are linked per record.

locations.name: Tropical Forest & Botanical Garden
locations.address: 5210 College Road
locations.accessNote: Garden admission required. See the official visitor page for current rates.

locations.accessibilityNote: Both restrooms are listed as ADA compliant by the garden operator.
